name: Rope of Entanglement
summary: A rope that entangles and restrains a creature on command.

stats.effect:
This rope is 30 feet long. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action to command the other end to dart forward and entangle one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the {ref:condition/restrained} condition. You can release the target by letting go of your end of the rope (causing the rope to coil up in the target's space) or by using a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} to repeat the command (causing the rope to coil up in your hand).

A target {ref:condition/restrained} by the rope can take an action to make its choice of a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer {ref:condition/restrained} by the rope. If you're still holding onto the rope when a target escapes from it, you can take a {ref:glossary/reaction} to command the rope to coil up in your hand; otherwise, the rope coils up in the target's space.

The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and {ref:glossary/immunity} to Poison and Psychic damage. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the rope drops to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points}, it is destroyed.
